context: Cage began writing about sex and culture while interning at the San Francisco-based magazine Future Sex. In 2000 she joined On Our Backs, the long-running lesbian erotica magazine founded in 1984, and served as its editor until 2005. Under her editorship, the magazine expanded its representation of lesbian sex and sexual identity.
